description: This source file defines the class DefaultIncomingMapping, which implements a mapping function that converts ExternalMessage objects into Adaptable objects by parsing JSON payloads and handling exceptions. It is part of the Java package related to Eclipse Ditto's connectivity mapping.

classes.name: DefaultIncomingMapping
classes.description: A singleton class implementing MappingFunction that converts ExternalMessage instances into lists of Adaptable objects by parsing JSON payloads and handling exceptions.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Converts an ExternalMessage to a list of Adaptable objects by parsing the JSON payload contained within the message.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of DefaultIncomingMapping.

methods.name: getPlainStringPayload
methods.description: Extracts the payload as a plain string from the ExternalMessage, attempting to decode byte payloads if text payload is absent.
